name: Generic Wideband (lambda x1000)
note: Lambda x1000, big-endian, in the first two bytes — the shape most controllers settle on, and the one to try first against a box whose protocol you do not have. It is also exactly a 14Point7 Spartan 3 in its factory format: CAN id 1024 (0x400) at 500 kbit, DLC 4, 50 Hz, with sensor temperature in byte 2 (x10 deg C) and a state in byte 3 (1 waiting, 2 heating, 3 running). The field arrives UNSET for a lambda sensor to consume. NOTE the Spartan 3 manual calls its format little-endian and then prints a big-endian formula; the formula is the truth.
